name: Paddle
label: Paddle — Paddle Billing API v1 (Paddle-Version 1)
description: Official Paddle Billing API v1 (Paddle-Version 1). Docs: https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/about. One node; operations via `operation`. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets. DO NOT BUILD Paddle Classic (vendors.paddle.com, vendor_id, vendor_auth_code). Sandbox: sandbox-api.paddle.com. Merchant of record; tax is Paddle’s. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) + provider signing/verification secret (webhook_secret) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Paddle. Secrets never on this port. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: transaction_list | product_list | subscription_get | subscription_cancel | customer_list | discount_create | discount_list | trigger. trigger (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: Environment
schema.description: sandbox-api.paddle.com vs api.paddle.com (keys are env-specific). Substituted into baseUrl as https://{environment}.

schema.label: Id
schema.description: Resource id when the path uses {id}.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: Query-string parameter `per_page` for operations: transaction_list, product_list, customer_list, discount_list.

schema.label: code
schema.description: discount_create unique checkout code. Example: SAVE20.

schema.label: enabled_for_checkout
schema.description: discount_create. Whether the code can be entered at checkout. Example: true.

schema.label: recur
schema.description: discount_create. true applies to recurring prices. Example: false.

schema.label: currency_code
schema.description: discount_create ISO 4217 when type is flat (not percentage). Example: USD.

schema.label: status
schema.description: transaction_list / product_list filter. Transactions: draft|ready|billed|paid|completed|canceled|past_due. Products: active|archived. Example: paid.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: transaction_list | product_list | subscription_get | subscription_cancel | customer_list | discount_create | discount_list | trigger. Default transaction_list. Selecting trigger (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) and provider verification fields (webhook_secret), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Paddle credential (bearer Authorization). StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Environment
configurationParameters.description: sandbox-api.paddle.com vs api.paddle.com (keys are env-specific). Substituted into baseUrl as https://{environment}.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.

configurationParameters.label: Notification Secret Key
configurationParameters.description: Paddle notification secret key for constant-time Paddle-Signature (ts=...;h1=...) HMAC-SHA256 verification. Never logged.
